---
title: 和の公べき乗式集 対称和形式
---

$$
S_k = \sum_{i=1}^{n-1} i^k(n-i)^k
$$


$$
\begin{aligned}
n^3 &= 6S_1 + n \\\\
n^5 &= 30S_2 + n \\\\
n^7 &= 140S_3 -14S_1 + n \\\\
n^9 &= 630S_4 - 1202S_1 + n \\\\
n^{11} &= 2772S_5 + 660S_2 - 1386S_1 + n \\\\
n^{13} &= 12012S_6 + 18018S_2 - 21840S_1 + n \\\\
n^{15} &= 51480S_7 - 60060S_3 + 491400S_2 - 450054S_1 + n \\\\
n^{17} &= 218790S_8 - 3712800S_3 + 15506040S_2 - 11880960S_1 + n \\\\
n^{19} &= 923780S_9 + 8817900S_4 - 196409840S_3 + 581981400S_2 - 394788954S_1 + n \\\\
n^{21} &= 3879876S_{10} + 1031151660S_4 - 10863652800S_3 + 26003271294S_2 - 16172552880S_1 + n \\\\
n^{23} &= 16224936S_{11} - \frac{9486595272}{5}S_5 + 93699005400S_4 - 664528044180S_3 + 1373080177128S_2 - \frac{4001808278118}{5}S_1 + n \\\\
n^{25} &= 67603900S_{12} - 374796021600S_5 + 8306600552250S_4 - \frac{137353191976000}{3}S_3 + 84902331848880S_2 -\frac{141149319311000}{3}S_1 + n \\\\
n^{27} &= 280816200S_{13}  + 562194032400S_6 - 53826771578580S_5 + 772611704865000S_4 \\\\ &- 3569645897868960S_3 + 6091385641040700S_2 - 3241087017089034S_1 + n \\\\
n^{29} &= 1163381400S_{14} + 173441819530980S_6 - 7169836621147200S_5 + 77639798278649880S_4 \\\\ &- 314662025229552000S_3 + 502685968450277370S_2 - 258667347324269520S_1 + n
\end{aligned}
$$
